Frequently Asked Questions

What makes a top interior design firm in Pitampura?

Good design, honest advice, detailed drawings and a team that is close by and visits the site regularly.

Do you work across North and West Delhi?

Yes. From our Pitampura office we work in Rohini, Shalimar Bagh, Model Town, Punjabi Bagh and the wider Delhi NCR.

Can I see your past projects?

Yes. We share photos and details of completed homes, offices and salons, and you can see them in our gallery.

Why choose a top interior design firm over individual vendors?

One firm coordinates design, materials and vendors, so you don't have to manage many people and the result stays consistent.
